title: Super Bowl XXXV
overview: Super Bowl XXXV, played on January 28, 2001, at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, saw the Baltimore Ravens dominate the New York Giants 34-7, securing the first Super Bowl victory in franchise history.  The Giants were heavy favorites based on their two previous Super Bowl titles, but Baltimore, returning to the Super Bowl for the first time since 1971 when the Colts made the city home, had a team whose defense was considered among the strongest ever seen.
